name: Physical Security Perimeter
description: Ensure physical security perimeters are defined and used to protect areas containing sensitive information and systems.

name: Physical Entry Controls
description: Ensure physical entry points are protected by appropriate access controls to prevent unauthorized access.

name: Securing Offices, Rooms and Facilities
description: Ensure offices, rooms, and facilities are secured to prevent unauthorized access, damage, or interference with information and systems.

name: Physical Security Monitoring
description: Ensure physical areas are monitored to detect and deter unauthorized access or security incidents.

name: Protecting Against Physical and Environmental Threats
description: Ensure measures are implemented to protect against physical and environmental threats.

name: Working in Secure Areas
description: Ensure procedures are in place for working in secure areas.

name: Clear Desk and Clear Screen
description: Ensure clear desk and clear screen policies are applied to reduce information exposure.

name: Equipment Siting and Protection
description: Ensure equipment is sited and protected to reduce risks from environmental threats and unauthorized access.

name: Security of Assets Off-Premises
description: Ensure security of assets when used outside organizational premises.

name: Storage Media
description: Ensure storage media is managed and protected throughout its lifecycle.

name: Supporting Utilities
description: Ensure availability and protection of supporting utilities such as power and telecommunications.

name: Cabling Security
description: Ensure power and telecommunications cabling is protected from interception or damage.

name: Equipment Maintenance
description: Ensure equipment is correctly maintained to ensure availability and integrity.

name: Secure Disposal or Re-use of Equipment
description: Ensure equipment is securely disposed of or reused to prevent information leakage.
